reviews.text: I was a customer for about two years, buying items approximately every two weeks. The store has a reasonable variety of products and several employees in uniform wearing blue shirts. The in-person service has been getting progressively worse. You arrive to pick up an item and can't pay directly at the register, causing a delay in service. It gets slower and slower; I think even the owner was there one of the last times and witnessed this embarrassing situation, which is poor service that doesn't meet customer expectations or experience. The last time I tried to buy something, the attendants taking orders were talking loudly and didn't even look at the customer arriving. Worse, when I directed the item to the register, the two people sitting opposite me turned away and continued chatting, quite engrossed in their conversation. Unfortunately, I don't recommend anyone go to this pet shop because the service is very slow, unprofessional, the prices aren't all that great, and there are other pet shops nearby.
